text: Down right in the dancing hall, a sweet girl's arms around him. He patiently endured. The doctor looked and said, oh my, he never can be cured. He doesn't drink. He doesn't smoke. A game of cards he'll never play. And once advised, he took advice from the great YMCA. He never yet has made a bet.
